campaign_thesis: AI is often described as software. Atlasoquence follows the physical chain beneath it—from data-centre demand into electricity, grids, materials and northern Chile—while keeping documented mechanisms, place connections and fiction visibly separate.

assets.copy:
AI looks weightless on a screen. Its consequences are not.

Atlasoquence follows the physical chain beneath AI: data-centre growth → electricity and grid demand → material demand → northern Chile → the human questions that follow.

The edition keeps three things separate: documented global mechanisms, documented place connections, and fictional human exploration.

Read AI's Physical Hunger on Atlasoquence.

AI is software sitting on physical systems.

Atlasoquence maps the chain: data centres → electricity/grid demand → materials → northern Chile → human consequences.

Facts stay facts. Fiction stays labelled fiction.

AI's Physical Hunger.

AI'S PHYSICAL HUNGER

Follow the physical consequences beneath AI—from data-centre demand through electricity, grids and materials to northern Chile. Documented mechanisms, place connections and fictional human exploration remain explicitly separated.

Find the change. Establish what is real. Follow where it goes. Map what follows.
